Let A = x'+z. Note A = x'+z. Use: if A is true, then A + X' = 1 (Complement law). Alternatively: (x'+z) + (x'+z)' = 1 (Complement law). Note that [x'y'+x'z+yz]' is the complement of the second factor. We show x'+z covers the expression: if x'=1 then F=1. If x'=0 (x=1): F = z + [0+0+yz]' = z + (yz)' = z + y' + z' (De Morgan) = (z+z') + y' (Associativity and Complementation) = 1 + y' = 1 (Annihilation law). Hence F=1.
